name: figma-computer-use
description: Operate Figma through computer-use, with internal manuals and version-aware maintenance.

interface.longDescription: Use computer-use for requested Figma inspection, design editing, prototyping, and export instead of Figma MCP. Includes distilled official and local-source guidance, observed UI verification, and a version baseline with a manual refresh workflow. Requires the host computer-use runtime; does not bundle a connector or MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use $figma-computer-use to edit the requested Figma design through computer-use and verify the result.
Use $figma-computer-use to refresh its Figma manuals and compatibility baseline, then version the skill.
